commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none}"; gh pr view 2038 --json number,headRefOid,baseRefName,title,state,closingIssuesReferences 2>&1 | head -50

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before
git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
